message.content: Invoice line totals truncate the fraction of a cent. Plan the fix to round half up and add an invoice total.

content.text: The plan is in docs/plans/line-total-rounding.md. Risk: critical — money. Task 1 changes lineTotal to round half up, and task 2 adds invoiceTotal on top of it; both touch src/billing, so I need your approval before building. Do you approve the plan?
